title: Paired Gesture · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paired Gesture · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and agree on two small, safe gestures. Each player performs one of the two gestures in the agreed order. Both gestures appear once and in the right order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paired Gesture, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Both gestures appear once and in the right order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Both gestures appear once and in the right order.
